### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

When running [`platform_tests/test_advanced_reboot.py::test_fast_reboot_from_other_vendor`](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/platform_tests/test_advanced_reboot.py#L103-L119), the test crashed in post-reboot validation due to a fixture:
```shell
AttributeError: 'FixtureFunctionDefinition' object has no attribute 'is_consistency_check_supported'
```

The PR [#16877](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/16877) added `consistency_checker_provider` to the advanced reboot parameters in the test, but it does not add `consistency_checker_provider` to the actual test parameters.

For example, `test_fast_reboot` passes `consistency_checker_provider` as a parameter
```python
def test_fast_reboot(request, get_advanced_reboot, verify_dut_health,           # noqa F811
                     advanceboot_loganalyzer, consistency_checker_provider,     # noqa F811
                     capture_interface_counters):
```
But `test_fast_reboot_from_other_vendor` does not
```
def test_fast_reboot_from_other_vendor(duthosts,  rand_one_dut_hostname, request,
                                       get_advanced_reboot, verify_dut_health,      # noqa: F811
                                       advanceboot_loganalyzer,  # noqa: F811
                                       capture_interface_counters):
```

### Steps to Reproduce

On sonic-mgmt 202511 branch, run `platform_tests/test_advanced_reboot.py::test_fast_reboot_from_other_vendor` as a single test

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Expected to pass/fail without attribute errors.

resolution.title: [platform] Add missing consistency_checker_provider fixture to test_fast_reboot_from_other_vendor
resolution.description:
### Description of PR
[agent]
Add the missing `consistency_checker_provider` fixture parameter to `test_fast_reboot_from_other_vendor`.

The test body passes `consistency_checker_provider` to `get_advanced_reboot()`, but the fixture was never declared as a test parameter, causing:
```
AttributeError: 'FixtureFunctionDefinition' object has no attribute 'is_consistency_check_supported'
```

All other reboot tests (`test_fast_reboot`, `test_warm_reboot`, etc.) already include this fixture in their signatures. This was introduced in PR #16877 which added the fixture to the function body but not the parameters.

Fixes: #22795

### Type of change
- [x] Bug fix

### How did you test it?
```
AST parse: OK
Verified consistency_checker_provider is now in function signature (line 105)
and matches the reference in get_advanced_reboot() call (line 116)
```
